decisions.statement: The pages are the system's own imported rather than restated.
A world is served by carrying the pages into its tree.
Every entry an index has is an entry a rebuild or a settle worked out from a page that exists.
A generator kind a property carried here names is carried too.
A property naming a kind that exists nowhere is refused rather than guessed at.
The page types a property hangs from are carried apart from the properties themselves.
A world with them settles what a page type of its own declares.
Every type a page type extends up to the root type is carried with it.
A world is served the same way whichever set of pages that world asks for.
A page naming its type by an address is filed under the slug that address ends in.

definition: the pages a test's world must carry before an identity can be filed
